description: enabled:false silences the HOSTED Mend Renovate app (installed org-wide, ticket 01): two Renovates fought over one branch on 2026-09-01 -- the hosted app rebased renovate/feeds-threat-register-2.x, consumed the retry checkbox, and cannot run postUpgradeTasks, so its commits can never carry the composed/ re-render and the self-hosted run then refuses the branch as externally modified. The self-hosted runner (renovate-run.yml) overrides this with RENOVATE_FORCE={"enabled":true}, which only a global config may set -- exactly one Renovate acts on this repo, and it is the one that can complete the bump.

customManagers.description: Cross-org bump surface #1 (ticket mo-10, ADR-0001/ADR-0002): the pinned nist regulator catalog. Renovate's native flux manager tracks a GitRepository's tag OR commit exclusively and cannot maintain the {tag, commit} pair ADR-0001 requires (post-merge tamper resistance) -- this customManager (git-refs datasource) does both together.
Cross-org bump surface #2 (ticket mo-10): the pinned platform dependency (config-base pattern). Same {tag, commit}-pair reasoning as the nist manager above.

Cross-org bump surface #3 (eco-system ticket 61, ADR-0019): the feed pins in party.yaml's inherits[]. A feed pin names a payload directory version (v1, v2); the feeds repo signs releases as per-feed tags (<name>/vX.Y.Z), so extractVersionTemplate maps the tag back to the directory version. Deferred by ticket 22 to ticket 21 and never written until ticket 61.

Cross-org bump surface #4 (eco-system ticket 61): the insurer's per-adopter quote feed pin in party.yaml. The insurer is a single-feed repo, so its tags are plain vX.Y.Z (like ico's release shape, unlike the feeds repo). ico's own penalty-schema line stays un-renovated on purpose: ico ships no git tags as a repo pin -- party.yaml documents that already.

Cross-org bump surface: the pinned ico parent (eco-system tickets 62 and 77). Until 2026-09-04 this parent was consumed at a branch and had no pin for Renovate to bump. Same {tag, commit}-pair reasoning as the nist and platform managers above.

Cross-org bump surface: the pinned feeds parent (eco-system tickets 62 and 77). Until 2026-09-04 this parent was consumed at a branch and had no pin for Renovate to bump. Same {tag, commit}-pair reasoning as the nist and platform managers above, with the one difference the `feeds` repo forces: it signs PER-FEED tags (`<name>/vX.Y.Z`), so a manager that captured the whole tag would hand `threat-register/v2.0.0` to semver versioning, which cannot parse it, and the pin would never be bumped. The feed prefix therefore stays OUTSIDE the capture group -- currentValue is the plain semver, Renovate rewrites only that substring and the prefix survives -- and extractVersionTemplate maps the datasource's per-feed tags back onto it. That is the shape the party.yaml feeds manager above already uses for the same reason.

Cross-org bump surface: the pinned insurer parent (eco-system tickets 62 and 77). Until 2026-09-04 this parent was consumed at a branch and had no pin for Renovate to bump. Same {tag, commit}-pair reasoning as the nist and platform managers above.
